_comment: sim-retreat-sensor-watchdog-scope-v1. Purpose: keep the per-frame /sensors SIM freshness watchdog (RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S) tight everywhere EXCEPT the phases where the collect capture is SILENT BY DESIGN -- the post-place retreat and stow at least. coldwin76/77/78 all completed the loaded set-down AND the contact-triggered release on the cart, then each died in the EMPTY RETREAT on a different watchdog counting a legitimately quiet period. run-78's was THIS watchdog: the phase-aware collect capture does not fire in retreat/stow, a 0.01 s MOVE_DEADLINE_RETRY phase=retreat drove a retry, the retreat ran past 40 sim-s, and the per-frame SIM bound expired against RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S=40 ('sensor stream watchdog expired', phase=retreat) -> collect StageRetry. This key BROADENS the PR 357 loaded-place-descent suspension (place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend) to EVERY capture-silent phase, so the tight default watchdog can come back instead of the cw79 whole-run env widen. Default off => byte-identical.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> RosTransferBridge, the HOST manip process).
_capture_silent_sensor_watchdog_suspend_:
Suspend the per-frame /sensors SIM-clock watchdog (RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S) over EVERY capture-silent phase (controller.in_capture_silent_window() == not isaac_sensors.sensing_render_required(phase); the authoritative _SENSING_SUSPEND_PHASES set: approach/contact/grasp/lift/preplace/place/retreat/release/stow/couple and the carry swing-outs tuck/pan/retreat_tuck). On entry it logs 'SENSOR_WATCHDOG_SUSPENDED phase=

reason=capture_silent ...' and on re-entry to a capture-bearing phase (observe / verify re-validation) 'SENSOR_WATCHDOG_REARMED phase=

reason=capture_silent_exit ...', so a run log shows the exact window. ONLY the per-frame SIM anchor is kept fresh; last_packet_wall is NEVER touched, so the /sensors WALL backstop (RESTOCK_SENSOR_STREAM_WALL_BACKSTOP_S, 600 s in cw77+) stays armed throughout and a genuinely frozen sim is still caught even inside the window. The PR 357 loaded-place-descent window is checked first, so with only place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend on the log/reason stay loaded_descent/place_descent_exit (byte-identical). Default off => byte-identical. Validated in tests/test_ros_adapter_watchdog.py (CaptureSilentSensorWatchdogScope).
_restore_tight_default: With this key ON, the standing tight RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S=40 (sim) can be RESTORED for the next hardening run -- remove the cw79 whole-run widen that loosened it as a stopgap (set RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S=40 in the run env, the pre-cw79 value run-78 carried). The phase-scoped suspension replaces the whole-run widen and keeps the watchdog tight in the capture-bearing phases (observe / verify). RESTOCK_SENSOR_STREAM_WALL_BACKSTOP_S stays at its cw77+ 600 s; RESTOCK_NAV_STUCK_SIM_S stays at 120 (the separate run-77 fix).
_pairs_with: This is the retreat/stow sibling of the PR 357 loaded-place-descent keys. For full coverage of the whole post-release tail keep the PR 357 place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend (HOST) + collect_place_station_pause (RUNTIME) ON as well (place-descent window) AND add this key for the retreat/stow window. See docs/examples/place-descent-watchdog-suspend-fragment.json.
_requires: Registered in config_preflight.KEY_CONSUMER (capture_silent_sensor_watchdog_suspend -> HOST), so a key filed in the RUNTIME config is refused before the GPU boot. Add it to the run's --require list so the preflight asserts it activated in the HOST process that reads it.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the coldwin78 config (GROUND-TRUTH collect, RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose with RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard, PR 333/334 place_contact_release + closed_loop_sensor, PR 339 station_place_full_brake, PR 357 place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend + collect_place_station_pause, the PR 368 release-cancel handshake) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with capture_silent_sensor_watchdog_suspend:true in the HOST block and RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S=40 restored (no cw79 whole-run widen), RESTOCK_NAV_STUCK_SIM_S=120. Expected PASS: the run reaches the set-down + contact release exactly as coldwin78 did, then in the empty retreat the host log shows SENSOR_WATCHDOG_SUSPENDED phase=retreat reason=capture_silent at retreat entry (and again for stow), NO HOST_FAULT 'sensor stream watchdog expired' even though the retreat runs past 40 sim-s under the MOVE_DEADLINE_RETRY, SENSOR_WATCHDOG_REARMED fires on re-entry to a capture-bearing phase, the collect stage completes (no StageRetry), and the mission continues toward the complete whole-run video. A genuinely frozen sim inside the window still hard-stops on the 600 s /sensors WALL backstop (named 'sensor stream wall backstop expired').
